name: Northern Lights
description: Slow curtains of northern light hanging from the top edge, behind your content.

props.name: colors
props.description: Band colours, cycled across the curtains. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the drift speed. The three depths loop in 88, 62 and 41 seconds at 1.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the light, from 0 to 1.

props.name: position
props.description: The edge the curtains hang from. The light fades out toward the opposite edge.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the effect. Other div props are passed through.
